// divguard:path internal/codingagent/interactive_turn.go

package codingagent

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
)

type statusError struct{ Status int }

func (e *statusError) Error() string { return "request failed" }

// describe classifies by the provider's status field.
func describe(err error, modelID string) string {
	if se, ok := errors.AsType[*statusError](err); ok && se.Status == 401 {
		return "Authentication failed. Run /login."
	}
	if strings.Contains(modelID, "400") {
		return "model id mentions 400"
	}
	return err.Error()
}
